targets.fit_rationale: Founded in 1838, second oldest historical society in Ohio. Digital archiving and genealogy tools would enhance their preservation mission and expand access to their collections.

contacts.name: General Contact
contacts.notes: Primary contact email for all ACHS inquiries. All-volunteer organization.

contacts.name: Stephanie Wardrop
contacts.notes: Board President (2025 Executive Committee), Madison OH, Term ends 12/31/2028. Leadership contact for partnership discussions.

contacts.name: Rhonda Wright
contacts.notes: Board Vice President (2025 Executive Committee), Ashtabula OH, Term ends 12/31/2026. Active in community - placed wreath at Ashtabula Train Disaster memorial.

targets.key_insight: All-volunteer organization with 11-member board. Best approach is through general email with attention to Executive Committee (President/VP). They operate 4 historic properties and are focused on preservation, education, and community engagement.

targets.fit_rationale: Maintains comprehensive genealogical sources and local history archives. Digital research tools would improve accessibility for family history researchers. Already digitizing newspapers with professional services.

contacts.name: Carrie Wimer
contacts.notes: Primary contact for genealogy/archives. Leads newspaper digitization projects. Active in community (hosts genealogy table at Log Cabin Days).

contacts.name: Michael Thornton
contacts.notes: Oversees library website and digital services. Previously Information Services Manager. MLIS from Kent State. Passionate about technology to make resources accessible.

contacts.name: General Reference
contacts.notes: General library contact. Archives researchers should contact in advance to confirm availability and ensure safe access/handling.

targets.key_insight: Professional library with dedicated Archives Librarian (Carrie Wimer) who manages digitization projects. Michael Thornton oversees digital resources - ideal for technical integration discussions. ACDL is an Affiliate Library for FamilySearch with access to restricted records.

researcher_notes.ACHS: All-volunteer organization with professional email (ashcohs@gmail.com). Board leadership changes annually via elections. 2025 Executive Committee: Wardrop (President), Wright (VP), Sowry (Secretary), Blessing (Treasurer).
researcher_notes.ACDL: Professional library staff with consistent email pattern (first initial + last name @acdl.info). Carrie Wimer confirmed as Archives Librarian through news articles. Michael Thornton confirmed via LinkedIn and staff page. Penny Neubauer is Director (pneubauer@acdl.info).
researcher_notes.outreach_strategy: For ACHS: Lead with general email, mention preservation/digital archive value. For ACDL: Contact Carrie Wimer directly for genealogy partnership, Michael Thornton for technical/digital integration.
